material_class.structural_family: end-to-end azido-pinned interlocking Dy4 squares / twisted Dy8 hexahedron

synthesis.procedure: 4,6-Dihydrazinopyrimidine (0.1 mmol) was dissolved in methanol/acetonitrile (1:3, 20 mL), salicylaldehyde (0.2 mmol) was added, and the mixture was stirred for 30 min to form the ditopic Schiff-base ligand H2L in situ. NaN3 (0.3 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol) were then added successively. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 5 h and left undisturbed for slow solvent evaporation. Green single crystals of Dy8L6 formed after about one week.
synthesis.time: 30 min ligand condensation, then 5 h after metal and azide addition; crystals after about one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The solution was left unperturbed; green single crystals were obtained by slow evaporation of MeOH/MeCN.
synthesis.yield: 25 mg (4.9%, based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Dy8L6 shows intramolecular ferromagnetic interactions and zero-dc-field SMM behavior, with a reported anisotropy barrier of 152(4) K, the largest then claimed among lanthanide azido-bridged SMMs. No magnetic hysteresis was observed down to 1.9 K.
